title: New Model Market-Entry Coordination Playbook
creator: Asha Patel
description: Playbook for coordinating the cross-functional go-to-market activities when adding a new model to the Redwood catalog. Covers catalog metadata ingestion, perf/quality benchmarks, engineering release notes and SDK changelog coordination, documentation localization, launch communications cadence, and post-launch monitoring and rollback criteria. Intended to be a one-stop checklist for PMs, Eng leads, Design, Docs, Marketing, and Support to reduce launch friction and ensure consistent messaging across channels.
acceptance_criteria: Model listing created in catalog with accurate tags, pricing tier, and verified performance profile
Benchmarks published to the internal performance dashboard and summary metrics included in release notes
Docs (quickstart, API examples, migration notes) are authored and reviewed for release
Release notes drafted and synchronized across SDK repos and Console changelog
Marketing assets (blog draft, email + social templates) ready and scheduled with embargo windows set
Support playbook and known limitations documented and linked to ticketing templates
Monitoring alerts and SLO dashboards instrumented for the new model and smoke tests green

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Benchmarks show higher-than-expected p95 latency in APAC. Mitigation: Gate APAC rollout to dedicated nodes and enable autoscale policy; add fallback to lower-capacity variant.
Risk: Docs lag behind SDK changes causing 1st-time API errors. Mitigation: Block launch until SDK PRs include stable examples; designate docs reviewer for SDK PRs.
Risk: Licensing or export control delay. Mitigation: Parallelize legal review and prepare conditional launch plan (EU/NA first).
Risk: Marketing embargo leak. Mitigation: Limit draft access, watermark assets, and prepare a brief reactive statement for transparency.
communication_plan: T-7 days: Internal announcement to GTM and Exec with benchmark highlights and launch checklist (Confluence link + calendar invite for pre-launch review)
T-2 days: Dry-run with console and SDK teams, finalize release notes and schedule publish times; confirm monitoring alert thresholds
Launch day: Publish blog + release notes at 10:00 PT, update console catalog at 10:05 PT, send customer announcement email to early access list at 10:15 PT
T+1 day: Slack update to #product and #engineering summarizing early telemetry and any support issues
T+3 days: Post-mortem/lessons learned sync and backlog grooming for follow-ups
